transformations: CUDEM NAD83 elevation reprojected to EPSG:32617 by bilinear interpolation at 500 m
depth derived as max(-elevation, 0); minimum depth 5 m; 250 m exclusion buffer rounded to one 500 m cell
RTOFS surface UOGRD/VOGRD reprojected independently by bilinear interpolation; coastal model-mask gaps filled from the nearest RTOFS wet cell only where CUDEM confirms navigable water
all routing arrays flipped together from raster north-up row order so increasing graph row is geographic north
NDBC latest records retained as contextual observations only
NOAA ENC/ENC Direct to GIS was audited as a future chart-constraint source but no unpinned chart feature changes the Navigation V2 mask
full raw 500 m/diagonal planner-node geometry is retained; no spline or decorative smoothing is applied
